uncontacted.title: Uncontacted leads
uncontacted.subtitle: Mark the leads nobody has reached yet, so they stand out until someone gets in touch. Nothing changes until you switch an option on.

clear.title: Mark as contacted
clear.intro: Automatically remove the Uncontacted marker when a team member does any of these:
clear.contactButton: Presses a contact button (call, SMS, email or WhatsApp) or places a call
clear.message: Sends a message, template, saved reply or file from the inbox
clear.automation: A campaign, broadcast or automated flow sends to the lead
clear.activity: Adds a note, meeting or other activity to the timeline
clear.manualHint: You can also change the marker by hand: open the More menu on a contact, or select several contacts and use More in the bar above the list.

new.title: Mark new leads as uncontacted
new.intro: When a lead is created in one of these ways, mark it as uncontacted:
new.import: Imported from a file or Google Sheets

reassign.title: Reassigned leads
reassign.intro: When a lead is assigned or reassigned to a new owner:

followUps.title: Follow-ups
followUps.subtitle: Keep every lead moving: when a team member gets in touch with a person, their next follow-up can be set or moved for them. Nothing changes until you switch an option on.

when.title: Automatically set follow-ups
when.intro: Whenever a team member contacts a person or sends them content, update their follow-up if:

date.title: Default follow-up date
date.intro: When a follow-up is updated automatically, set it to:
date.somedayHint: The follow-up has no date and waits in the Someday list. It is never reminded.
date.noneHint: The open follow-up is marked done and no new one is made.

time.title: Default follow-up time
time.intro: Whenever a new follow-up is created, set the alert time to:
time.hint: Read on your workspace's time zone.

followUp.title: Next follow-up
